chain_words.nuance: happening or appearing not long ago
new in kind and unlike what came before
general sense of not previously known or existing
new and deliberately creative in approach
so new that nothing similar has happened before

explanation: These words all express the idea of newness, from something that has only just appeared to something with no earlier parallel.

usage_notes.difference: 'Recent' describes time, meaning it happened not long ago; 'new' describes something that has not existed before, regardless of when it appeared.
